name: B.M. Birla Planetarium, Science Museum & Dinosaurium
description: World-class planetarium, interactive science museum, and dinosaurium built on the adjacent hill.

name: Hussain Sagar Lake & Monolithic Buddha Statue
description: Historic artificial lake with a massive single-stone Buddha statue situated in the center of the lake.

name: Lumbini Park & Musical Laser Fountain Show
description: Popular urban park offering speed boat rides to the Buddha Statue and evening musical laser fountain shows.

name: NTR Gardens & NTR Ghat
description: Landscaped urban recreational gardens along the banks of Hussain Sagar Lake.

name: Telangana State Archaeology Museum
description: Located in Public Gardens, housing historic artifacts, ancient coins, and Egyptian mummy exhibits.

name: Salar Jung Museum
description: One of India's premier national museums housing a vast private collection of art, sculptures, and rare manuscripts.

name: Charminar & Laad Bazaar
description: Iconic 16th-century monument and bustling historic market famous for traditional bangles and pearl jewelry.

name: Golconda Fort
description: Majestic fortress complex renowned for acoustic engineering and historical diamond trade.
